en: The postcard shows an old, sepia-toned photograph of a large gravestone or memorial stone in a park or cemetery. The stone is tall, rough-hewn, and oval-shaped, featuring an inscription plaque dedicated to 'Wilh. von Braun.' The scene is surrounded by leafless trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. There is some decorative greenery at the base of the stone and more stone structures nearby. Handwritten or printed text appears at the bottom of the card.
